development_approach.strategy: Pure data + artifact additions. Step 1: edit codex-render-fixtures-data.ts to add a webOpenTool factory const (mirror webSearchTool) and a web-open fixture entry (mirror web-search entry) using the input shape `{ url: 'https://example.com/open' }` and a result with status 'completed' + a sensible summary string. Step 2: rebuild the dev frontend image via scripts/dev-overnight-build-deploy.sh and verify health endpoint. Step 3: navigate Playwright to the live fixture URL with auth, probe DOM for the literal 'web.open' string, capture matrix-desktop.png and matrix-mobile.png. Step 4: at desktop viewport, scroll each of the three §5.3.B rows into view and capture per-row screenshots. Step 5: run typecheck and inspector chain on cycle-3 diff.
development_approach.validation_approach: Static: grep for 'web.open' in modified file (≥1 match). Build: scripts/dev-overnight-build-deploy.sh frontend then curl health endpoint. Live DOM: Playwright navigation + getByText/evaluate count of 'web.open' substring (≥1). Screenshots: file-existence + non-empty + visual inspection that rendered preview content is present. Cleanliness: yarn typecheck + style/cleanliness/prompt inspectors on cycle-3 diff scope. Safety: dev report self-attests no forbidden actions per CLAUDE.md ABSOLUTE PROHIBITIONS.
